_note: A COMPONENT board — its own layer name says so ('code:
MilestoneSuggestionBanner.tsx') — drawing all three states of one banner in a
600-wide gallery frame. `useAutoMilestone` only produces a suggestion after
the engine has watched a real editing session cross a trigger threshold, so
the component is mounted directly, inside the 280 drawer it actually ships
in.
WHAT DRIFTED — the three buttons, and it was the whole action row:
· 433:2359 draws Edit as btn/SECONDARY (white chip, --bk-border edge) and
only 433:2361 Dismiss as the ghost. BOTH shipped ghost, so 'keep this
suggestion and rename it' and 'throw it away' were the same control.
· the labels are 11/500; they shipped 12.
· the ghost's label is ink-SOFT (433:2362); it shipped ink-muted.
· every button is 10 across and 5 DOWN. `.milestone-btn` set a fixed 24
height and `padding: 0 10px` — zero block padding, an invented height.
The rules moved one class deeper (`.milestone-banner .milestone-btn`) so
they cannot lose to flowbite's own h-10/px-5 on source order; that trap
is what a single-class rule beside a `tw:` utility hits.
· 433:2352 is a flex column with a 2px gap; the three lines carried their
own margins, so the spacing belonged to the children rather than to the
stack and changed when the name became an input.
NOT anchored, and why:
433:2350 the banner FRAME — 600 wide, which is the gallery's width, not a
surface. The banner ships full-bleed inside a 280 drawer (`margin: 0 12px`).
Its other eight properties were measured against the board before the
target was skipped and every one matched (2026-09-08: fill #ebf5ff, border
--bk-alpha-accent-30, gap 8, padding 8/12, radius 8).
433:2351 icon/clock — a 16px ring the board draws as a bordered circle and
the code draws as an SVG stroke; there is no border-color pair to compare.
433:2365 editing / 433:2377 saving — the same three properties per element
as the suggested state, on the same components. The states themselves ARE
built (the input opens on Edit; the primary disables and shows '…' while
saving — the ellipsis is now the board's single glyph, it was '...'), but
measuring them here would re-measure the same CSS through a second click
path.
ACTION-ROW WRAP, seen and left: the board keeps the three buttons inline
beside the content. At 280 they cannot be — 'Save · Edit · Dismiss' at 11px
with their insets is ~162 of a 230 inner width, which leaves 36 for the
version name. The code wraps them onto their own row (`flexBasis: 100%`).
A 600 gallery frame does not adjudicate a 280 drawer; this is the same
class of question BLOCKERS B1 holds for Compare.
CONTRAST: two failures at 4.38 — the trigger line and the reasoning line,
ink-muted on the accent tint, which is exactly what 433:2353/433:2355 paint
on 433:2350. Not introduced here (both colours predate this pass) and the
same pair history-saves-changes already baselines for the entry time.
BOARD-COPY (2026-09-08): three leads, all of them the gallery's own state
captions — 'SUGGESTED' (433:2349), 'EDITING' (433:2364), 'SAVING' (433:2376).
They label the three specimens on the sheet; nothing renders them and nothing
